# Uses of the proposed array syntax

*Generated by `tools/array-syntax-uses.py`; do not edit.*

SPARQL-array reaches into a sequence with **position patterns** `((element))[index]` (index an integer, a variable or `*`) and the functions `isSEQ`, `SEQLEN`, `SEQ` and `expr[i]`; ShEx-array constrains one with the **Collection shape expression** `((shapeExpr))[min, max]`. Both are the syntax proposed today, deliberately alike, and expected to change with the ongoing research on array syntax. These are the files a change of syntax has to rewrite; the tests that use the SPARQL forms also say so with `mf:requires ra:PositionPatterns` or `ra:SequenceFunctions`, and the ShEx ones with `ra:CollectionShapeExpression`.
